purpose: Source control plane for NFL intelligence. Coverage and point-in-time integrity are separate from angle desirability.

status_vocabulary.AUDITED: Repository has explicit source audit/provenance evidence for stated use.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: Some repository evidence exists; contract incomplete for intended use.
status_vocabulary.PROSPECTIVE_ONLY: Usable only from captured future snapshots unless a legitimate historical archive is established.
status_vocabulary.REAUDIT_REQUIRED: Previously referenced source must be rechecked before new modeling use.
status_vocabulary.RIGHTS_OR_COST_REVIEW: Potentially useful but access/licensing/cost must be resolved.

sources.historical_coverage_claim: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast coverage begins around 2021-2022; Previous Runs provides fixed 1-7 day lead-time archives mostly from Jan 2024 (some model fields deeper); Single Runs preserves exact run initialization, with ECMWF IFS HRES from Mar 2024 and most other models from Apr 2026.
sources.current_season_policy: for each game capture exact run initialization and lead time at defined clocks; preserve weather model/provider, stadium coordinates, valid time and raw response digest
restrictions: Historical Forecast stitched series is not identical to one exact forecast run
model versions change across years
older ERA5/reanalysis is outcome-context research, not a pregame forecast
roof status must gate outdoor weather exposure

sources.current_season_policy: use completed prior games only; preserve date_pulled/source release and nflverse game/play ids; current target game's charting is never available pregame

2022 primary-read coding differs from 2023+ (primary reads may be NA in 2022)
not raw tracking coordinates
charting arrives after games and is only prior-history for future targets
coverage/schema must be audited season by season before modeling
